findings.message: `HeaderProject` is a second, hand-written copy of `ProjectHeaderData["project"]` from contracts.ts. The two can drift: if the contract gains a header field, the slot's `Header` will pass it on, but `ProjectHeader` won't render it, and nothing will fail to compile. Fix: derive the type with `type HeaderProject = ProjectHeaderData["project"]`, or import it from contracts.
findings.scenario: Add a field to ProjectHeaderData.project for a new header element → Allocations' Team tab loads it but never shows it; every check stays green.

findings.message: When a project has no releases at all, the map says 'No active releases on X. Switch to All to see past ones.' There are no past ones to see, and clicking All only shows 'No releases on X yet.' Fix: when `releases.length === 0`, show the 'No releases yet' line whatever the Active/All choice, and keep the 'Switch to All' hint for when releases exist but none are active. Then update the AC7 e2e string to match.
findings.scenario: Open /delivery/p/AMX/releases (0 releases) → told to switch to All → All shows 'No releases on amax yet.'

findings.message: Allocations' Team card uses the `.card-head.start` and `.note` styles, which are defined only in modules/delivery/ui/delivery.css. It gets them only because Delivery's Header, rendered through the slot, imports that stylesheet. That is a hidden cross-module style dependency. Fix: define the card-head variant the Team card uses in allocations.css, or move it to @amax/ui in its own platform change.
findings.scenario: Delivery's Header stops importing delivery.css, or lazy-loads it → the Team card's 'From allocations' note loses its right alignment and nowrap, and the head wraps.

findings.message: The Team page now calls Delivery's `slot.load`, which is `projectHeader` → `getProject`/`listEnvironments`. Both go through Delivery's `read()`, and that throws `ForbiddenError` without `delivery:read`. HR has `allocations:read` but Delivery grants it no `delivery:read` (only Leadership, Finance, Engineer and PM have it). Before this change an HR user could see a project's Team. Now the load throws and the page errors. The contract in the README says `load` returns the data or null, and the page treats null as 'Project not found'. A refused read is neither of those, and nothing on the page tells the two apart. Fix: make the slot's load say 'not allowed' separately from 'no such project' (return a tagged result, or catch `ForbiddenError` inside `projectHeader`). On that result the Team page should show a fallback header or a 'Delivery isn't open to your role' state. It should not crash, and it should not read as 'Project not found'. Add HR to the variant test in team-header-122.test.ts, driven through the real Delivery slot and not a hand-made `load`.
findings.scenario: An HR user (allocations:read, no delivery:read) opens /delivery/p/CON/team → `slot.load` throws ForbiddenError("delivery:read") → the page errors instead of showing the team it showed before 122.

findings.message: `projectHeader` builds a header from `getProject`, which also loads every active proposal of the project. The header uses only `project`, so every tab (and the Team page, through the slot) runs the full proposal query just to draw a title and a lede. Read only the project row and its environments for the header.
